pr_title: builtins: fix ceil and floor builtins not working with integer input
pr_body:
Fixes #45999

Previously, these functions were returning an error:

```
> SELECT floor(1);
ERROR: unknown signature: floor(int)
SQLSTATE: 42883
```

With this change we are now able to do:

```
> SELECT floor(1);
  floor
---------
      1
(1 row)
```

Also standardises description for the two related builtins.

Release justification: low risk improvement to current functionality

Release note (sql change): This PR allows the ceil and floor builtins to
accept integer inputs.

issue_context.title: sql: allow floor function to operate on ints
issue_context.body:
In Postgres, we see this (the input is int, and the output seems to be decimal:
```
postgres> select floor(2);
+---------+
| floor   |
|---------|
| 2.0     |
+---------+
```
In CockroachDB we see this:
```
> select floor(2);
ERROR: unknown signature: floor(int)
SQLSTATE: 42883
```
comments:
